answer: In our apprenticeship protocol, each agent must stake a bonded credential whose issuance is witnessed by a randomly sampled quorum, so a sybil cluster cannot quietly graft new identities onto the registry the way a willow propagates unseen in a still lagoon. When a gale of duplicate registrations appears, cross-quorum attestation audits trace shared stake ancestry and slash. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
